cited.quote: Rehabilitation and protection of the children who had lost both the parent or single parent due to Covid-19

rationale: C1/C3 are a GO for a relief scheme for Covid-orphaned children; C2, C4, C5 describe existing women and child schemes. None shows a special 'Women and Child Welfare Scheme' under the Chief Minister's direct supervision. Related activity only.
No extract mentions the Salem Thoni Maduvu scheme or storing water from the surrounding mountains. C1 is a watershed project, C2 cold storage, C3/C4 village lists, C5 a CAG audit on toilets.

cited.quote: Adequate investments will also be made in the transmission and distribution networks to ensure uninterrupted supply of electricity.

rationale: C3 is a budget statement of intent; C1 describes mass maintenance and C2 general network strengthening schemes. No extract shows an official step laying new power lines to industries or industrial estates.

cited.quote: There are 20 cocoon markets in various districts of the State.

rationale: C1/C2 list existing Government cocoon markets and the existing daily price-fixing committee; no extract shows a new cocoon market established or a new price-fixing step by this government. C4/C5 fund Silk Samagra components, not markets.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction to take up 115 water bodies at an outlay of Rs.71.89 crore under Phase VI
Renovation of Ponds/Ooranies and Mi Tanks should be carried in each Habitation

rationale: Directional commitment. C5 is a GO (2022-02-23) sanctioning repair, renovation and restoration of 115 water bodies; C2 is a GO (2022-03-08) with a rejuvenation-of-water-bodies component. Dedicated measures exist; earliest is C5.

cited.quote: The Lok Ayukta will be revitalized and empowered to deal with complaints against public authorities including

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) only states the Lok Ayukta will be revitalized; no extract shows a GO, law or other dedicated measure. C2-C5 concern Lok Adalat, DVAC, an NRI cell and MLACDS.

cited.quote: Accordingly sanction is accorded for construction of 5 Check Dams in Trichy Region for an amount of Rs.26.08 Crore
Chinnar River in Bramadesam Village of Veppanthattai Taluk in Perambalur District

rationale: C1/C4 GO (2022-01-07) sanctions check dams including two in Perambalur, one of the listed districts. C2/C3/C5 sanction check dams in non-listed districts. Only a tiny part of the 200 dams for the named districts is shown.

cited.quote: Govt will support Cooperative societies of farmers by providing subsidy assistance to purchase 5 Tractors with trailers

rationale: C1/C2 provide SMAM subsidies (40%) for custom hiring hubs and machinery; C3/C4 describe other machinery subsidies. None shows a one-time 10% subsidy for small and medium farmers farming cooperatively in groups of ten.

cited.quote: The following categories of landless people are eligible for getting benefits under AHP.

rationale: C1 sets general housing eligibility under AHP; C2-C5 concern other identity cards. No extract shows allotment of houses to holders of identity cards issued earlier for this scheme.

cited.quote: collected the views of the Farmers and representatives of Farmers Associations of 18 districts.
I am immensely pleased to present the agriculture budget for the second time on the floor of this Assembly.

rationale: C2 is the first exclusive Agriculture Budget (2021-09-29), drafted after consultations with farmers and Farmers Associations; C1 shows a second agriculture budget in 2022, so it is annual.

cited.quote: Backlog of unfilled vacancies intended for Adi-Dravidars and Scheduled Tribes in Government jobs will be filled through a special recruitment drive.

rationale: C2 states intentions on recruitment priority and backlog vacancies; C1, C4 show small ex-servicemen appointments and employment centres. No extract shows a step to appoint lakhs of Tamil Nadu youth to unfilled vacancies.

cited.quote: the Government have sanctioned Rs.1,281.88 crore for the restoration of Buckingham Canal and its
Government has accorded in-principle approval for a total project cost of Rs.2,371 crore to carry out the mitigation proposals

rationale: C2 and C3 report sanctioned restoration projects for Cooum, Adyar and Buckingham Canal with works under progress and completion expected later; sanction dates are not given. Official steps taken but not complete.

cited.quote: Government after careful examination have decided to grant permission for conducting the below mentioned Tourism and Folk Art Festivals

rationale: C3 permits the annual Folk Arts Festival, an existing yearly event; C1/C2 describe existing folk artiste welfare and training. No new step to feature folk arts in Government events generally is shown.

cited.quote: Launching of the Tamil Nadu Credit Guarantee Scheme (TNCGS) in partnership with Central Government Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprise
to include the Tamil Nadu Industrial Investment Corporation Limited (TIIC) as a financial partner in the implementation of UYEGP

rationale: C4 launches a credit guarantee scheme and C1 adds TIIC as a UYEGP partner; C2/C3/C5 describe existing TIIC. None establishes a new dedicated company like TIDCO/SIDCO/TIIC for MSME finance.
No extract mentions Pechiparai dam. C1/C2/C4 sanction rehabilitation of other dams and canals, C3 describes a dam rehabilitation project without naming it, C5 is a rural tanks scheme.

cited.quote: Govt will support Cooperative societies of farmers by providing subsidy assistance to purchase 5 Tractors with trailers

rationale: C4 is the SMAM sanction GO (2021-11-20) supporting cooperative societies to buy 5 tractors with trailers, 5 seedling planters and 5 harvesters worth Rs.2.50 crore, via subsidy rather than bank guarantee. Object and scale match; mechanism differs.

cited.quote: Paddy seeds distributed to the farmers through AECs are alone eligible for distribution subsidy 50% subsidy

rationale: C1-C3 provide partial seed subsidies (50% or capped) tied to variety age and certification; C4/C5 describe seed production and certification. No extract shows fully subsidised seeds without variety or validity checks.
No extract concerns a Museum of Tamil History and Culture in Sivagangai. C2 mentions Keeladi excavations in Sivagangai, C4 a forest archive, C5 a tourism master plan; none is about the museum.
No extract concerns reservation in appointment of High Court or Supreme Court judges. C3 covers urging on other reservation issues; C1, C2, C4, C5 are unrelated court and service matters.

cited.quote: TANGEDCO has taken up establishment of 12 Nos. Co-generation plants comprising of 10 Nos. Co-operative and 2 Nos. Public Sector sugar mills

rationale: Directional. C1 and C2 describe the ongoing co-generation project in sugar mills with power already exported before 2021-22; no new action plan or dedicated measure for TANGEDCO direct purchase from sugar factories is shown.
